**Stable ID:** `DATA-01.01` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 01 Scope, taxonomy and governance

Decide what counts as a dataset, benchmark, split, derived dataset or evaluation suite for this directory, and what is excluded.

## Deliverables

- Versioned inclusion and exclusion rules with worked boundary examples
- Decision record approving the rules

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/charter.md`
- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each boundary example cites the public dataset card or paper that makes it a boundary case

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every entity kind has an inclusion rule, an exclusion rule and at least two boundary examples
- [ ] Rules distinguish datasets, benchmarks, benchmark runs and benchmark results
- [ ] A decision-register entry records the approval and reviewer

## Non-goals

- Collecting or listing any dataset record
- Changing the frozen T0-T6 builder contract

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-01.01.T1` Draft entity-kind definitions
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T1.S1` Define dataset, benchmark, split, subset and derived dataset
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T1.S2` Define benchmark run and benchmark result as separate kinds owned outside this repository
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T1.S3` Record the source of each definition
- [ ] `DATA-01.01.T2` Write inclusion and exclusion rules
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T2.S1` Write one inclusion and one exclusion rule per kind
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T2.S2` Add at least two boundary examples per kind
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T2.S3` List known ambiguous cases as open questions
- [ ] `DATA-01.01.T3` Approve and record the charter
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T3.S1` Open a decision-register entry
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T3.S2` Obtain independent review
  - [ ] `DATA-01.01.T3.S3` Link the approved charter from README

## Dependencies

- No prerequisite work packages.
- Blocks `DATA-01.02`, `DATA-02.01`, `DATA-04.01`

## Review requirements

- Research lead maintainer
- Independent dataset research reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.
